content: What was the fix for that Metal crash we had?
[id:45] (distance: 0.06) Fixed Metal crash when window is minimized — guard zero-dimension depth texture in rebuildDepthTexture(). Also pause/resume MTKView on window miniaturize/deminiaturize.

The Metal crash fix (memory 45): The crash was caused by a zero-dimension depth texture when the window was minimized. The fix had two parts:

1. Guard in `rebuildDepthTexture()` to prevent creating textures with zero dimensions
2. Pause/resume the MTKView on window miniaturize/deminiaturize events
